Spigot
Agentic Economy · ArcRepo
Streaming settlement on Arc, built for autonomous agents

Agents that pay by the second, and know when to stop.

An autonomous agent streams a metered service, pays one tick of USDC for each second it holds, and shuts its own gate the moment the next second stops being worth the price. Every tick is a real settlement. No subscription, no human clicking pay.

Live demo, running the real agent loop in mock mode. Click and watch.

How it works

01

Open a session

The agent, holding a Circle wallet on Arc, opens a metered session with a budget, a rate ceiling, and a goal.

02

Pay per tick

Each second it weighs the next chunk's value against its price. Worth it, it settles one USDC tick on Arc.

03

Close the gate

When value drops below cost, or the budget runs out, the agent stops on its own and records why.

Proof, not trust. The settlement layer runs on meter402, an open-source npm package, and publishes a snapshot that never claims more than it settled. Live on Arc, an on-chain verifier re-derives every total straight from the chain.
